selected.where: while n % 6 == 0: checks divisibility by composite 6 after removing factors 2 and 3
selected.how: Assumes 6 is a prime factor; the condition is unreachable because 2 and 3 are already removed, so 6 never divides n.
selected.what: Input 6 returns 1 (incorrect) instead of 3; any multiple of 6 fails to update largest correctly.

selected.where: while n % 9 == 0: checks divisibility by composite 9 after removing factor 3
selected.how: Assumes 9 is a prime factor; the condition is unreachable because all factors of 3 are removed earlier.
selected.what: Input 9 returns 1 (incorrect) instead of 3; any multiple of 9 fails to update largest correctly.

selected.where: if n > 1: return n assumes remaining n is prime
selected.how: Assumes all composite factors are removed; but since 6 and 9 checks are unreachable, composite factors like 49 (7*7) might remain if 7 was not fully divided.
selected.what: Input 49 returns 49 (incorrect) instead of 7; composite numbers with factors >19 are returned as primes.
